title: lifedraft input contract — universal $defs: shared primitives and cross-cutting shapes
$comment: Fragment of the universal input contract, merged into schema/input_schema.json by input_contract.load_universal_schema() -- see that function and compose_schema() for the exact, total merge rule. This file is a FRAGMENT, not a standalone schema: its "#/$defs/..." references resolve only in the composed document. Scalar primitives and identifiers every other fragment refers to (money, rate, date, the four *_id patterns), the owner_ref share-split shape, the jurisdiction-agnostic province placeholder, and the provenance sidecar's entry shape. Referenced from every other fragment; refers to none of them.

date.description: RFC 3339 full-date (YYYY-MM-DD). Precision to the day, so month-granularity rules (CPP/OAS onset) and day-granularity rules (FHSA 15-year window, RRIF-at-71) are exact, not approximated to a year (#597).

person_id.description: Stable identifier, referenced by accounts/liabilities/properties/estate/decisions. Never role text ('primary'/'spouse') — a role is a label, not an identity (#598).

province.description: Jurisdiction-agnostic placeholder — a non-empty string. The Canada overlay replaces this $def wholesale with the closed enum of provinces/territories (long form only; #595 flagged 'qc' vs 'quebec' as a self-inconsistent example in the old schema).

owner_ref.description: A single person, or a jointly-held asset/liability split by percentage. Reused by account/liability/property owner fields.

money.description: A non-negative dollar amount in the document's declared currency/dollars units. Debts are recorded as positive magnitudes on liabilities, never as negative assets.

signed_money.description: A dollar amount that may legitimately be negative (e.g. a cash-flow outflow).

rate.description: An annual rate as a fraction (0.07, not 7). Negative allowed for stress scenarios (crash years, deflation).

as_of.description: Statements arrive on different dates; this need not equal the document's root as_of (#597).

provenance_entry.description: One leaf's provenance (#660). `measured` MUST carry `source` + `as_of`; `assumed`/`stated` MUST carry `plausible_range` OR `domain` -- mandatory for `assumed` because nobody chose that value, the engine or author guessed it. Whether a `plausible_range`/`domain` actually BRACKETS the leaf's live value, and whether the pointer itself resolves, are cross-document checks jsonschema cannot express here -- see provenance.load_provenance().

confidence.description: measured=traceable to a document; stated=user asserted, no document; derived=computed from other facts; assumed=the engine or author guessed (range/domain mandatory); unknown=genuinely absent (engine refuses at load, DP#32).

source.description: A URI, e.g. file:///path/to/statement.pdf#page=1 -- include a page anchor where applicable. Required when confidence=measured.

as_of.description: The date the source document was true. Required when confidence=measured.

plausible_range.description: [lo, hi], inclusive, bracketing the leaf's current value. One of plausible_range/domain is required when confidence is assumed or stated.

domain.description: The set of values this leaf may plausibly hold; must contain the leaf's current value. One of plausible_range/domain is required when confidence is assumed or stated.

resolved_by.description: Free text: what a human should go DO to upgrade this leaf to measured (e.g. "Read the will."). Optional at every confidence level.
